title: Abba Cottage & Carriage House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Accommodating up to 16 guests across the main house and a newly constructed carriage house, this beachfront paradise ensures a memorable stay. The first floor features a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bath, while the primary bedroom boasts a luxurious soaking tub and walk-in shower upstairs. Additional guest and bunk rooms and a second primary bedroom with Gulf views complete the second floor. The carriage house offers a king bedroom, a full kitchen, a living area with a queen sleeper sofa, and Gulf views from the second-floor porch. Just steps from the beach and with six adult bikes provided, you can easily explore the charming streets of Rosemary Beach. Guests also have access to the nearby Coquina Pool, open daily from 9:00 am to 9:00 pm. Experience ultimate luxury and tranquility at this exquisite beach rental, thoughtfully curated for an unforgettable stay. Book today and immerse yourself in the beauty of Rosemary Beach.
